name: livewall
description: Animated video wallpapers behind your code, on their own compositor layer.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Every setting is application-scoped, so a workspace cannot influence what LiveWall renders or writes.

commands.title: Remove wallpaper and restore VS Code

livewall.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the wallpaper. Turning it off hides it immediately without unpatching VS Code - the status bar item toggles this. Use **LiveWall: Remove wallpaper and restore VS Code** to undo the patch itself.

livewall.media.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the wallpaper. Video (`.mp4`, `.webm`, `.mov`) or animated image (`.gif`, `.webp`, `.apng`); still images work too. `~` is supported. Easiest set via **LiveWall: Choose wallpaper...**

livewall.library.markdownDescription: Local folder listed under the *My library* source in the gallery, watched for new files, and where the gallery saves downloads.

livewall.downloadSites.markdownDescription: Sites opened by the **Browse online…** button in the gallery. Opens in your real browser, so downloads work normally; save into `#livewall.library#` and they appear on their own. Add your own freely.

livewall.shuffle.markdownDescription: Use every file in `#livewall.library#` as a playlist instead of the single file in `#livewall.media#`. New files dropped in the folder are picked up automatically.

livewall.rotateMinutes.markdownDescription: Minutes between wallpapers when `#livewall.shuffle#` is on. `0` picks one at startup and keeps it.

livewall.pixabayApiKey.markdownDescription: Free key from [pixabay.com/api/docs](https://pixabay.com/api/docs/) for video search. 100 req/min, 5000 req/h, no monthly cap.

livewall.pexelsApiKey.markdownDescription: Free key from [pexels.com/api](https://www.pexels.com/api/) for video search. 200 req/h and 20 000 req/month.

livewall.video.markdownDeprecationMessage: Deprecated - use `#livewall.media#`. Still read as a fallback.

livewall.scrim.description: Darkening layer between the wallpaper and the UI. Higher = more readable text. This is the readability dial: unlike opacity, it is a fixed sheet, so a bright frame can never blow out your text.

livewall.playbackRate.markdownDescription: Playback speed. Below `1` is calmer and cheaper. Video only - animated images are driven by the browser and expose no speed control.

livewall.pauseOnBlur.markdownDescription: Pause when the VS Code window loses focus. Focusing a webview panel does not count as losing focus. Video only - animated images cannot be paused.

livewall.respectReducedMotion.markdownDescription: Do not animate when the OS requests reduced motion (macOS: Settings > Accessibility > Display > Reduce motion). Set to `false` to animate anyway. Video only - animated images cannot be stopped.
